  WHY: Without a test simulating this pagination-shift scenario, CI will not catch the reported status-scan skip.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:379-395, 478-495 | severity=high | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Offset-based pagination through Actions run listings can miss a newly created review run inserted at position 0 between page reads; the accumulated runs length may then not be divisible by `REVIEW_RUNS_PER_PAGE`, causing `_read_active_runs_past_listing` to skip its status-filtered fallback scan.
  WHY: The new run can be absent from both the active list and `bound_reviews`, allowing `evaluate` to proceed through the comment re-read to auto-merge. A complete miss is described as practically unreachable because review initialization takes seconds while the interval to the comment re-read is likely under 100 ms; an active run matters when the accumulated page count is not a multiple of 100, and the comment re-read already names this window as accepted risk.

  WHY: A newly created active run can be absent from the accumulated list, and the status scan that would catch it is skipped, allowing auto-merge while the newer review is running.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:414-434 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Offset-based pagination races with run creation, so a new run between page reads shifts subsequent pages and makes the accumulated listing length check unreliable.
  WHY: A short final page caused by the shift can make the function skip the status scan, even though that scan would catch the new active run in the current listing.
- tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:test_an_older_active_review_past_the_marker_page_keeps_the_pr_pending | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No test covers a new run created between page reads that causes the accumulated length to be non-divisible by 100 while the listing still has more items.
  WHY: Existing tests cover a full first page reaching the marker or a short last page that genuinely ends the listing, but do not simulate this pagination shift; the scenario is plausible given periodic sweep and forced review dispatches.
- Requirement: "Before enabling auto-merge, check PR-scoped review runs, including default-branch dispatches; defer while a newer run is active and authorize only against the latest completed review." (issue #5148 recommendation)
  Expected change site: scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py, _read_active_runs_past_listing() — the check that decides whether the status scan runs

When a new run is created between page reads, the accumulated length is not a multiple of 100, the scan is skipped, and the new active run is missed. The audit's core requirement — never enable auto-merge while a newer review is still running — is not fully met in this edge case.
